about: FX-34. One hostile refusal-detail= line as a runner given no line token prints it (the controller's row adds its Job's token, which this file does not hold); the terminal condition message weirkeeper stores for it; and the same message as a writer that cleaned nothing would have stored it. Read by BOTH sides: crates/weirkeeper/tests/restore_controller.rs proves the controller stores `storedMessage` for `detailLine`, and ui/tests/condition-message.spec.js proves the console shows `storedMessage` and `uncleanedMessage` as inert text. Non-ASCII is written as \u escapes so this file carries no live bidi control.
